## About
Metal Mites started in Jerry Cervak's garage. The name came from Jerry's wife, who used it for the metal caricatures Jerry made as a hobby. Jerry and the late Jim Vacala built the shop together, moved to Brookfield, and then rehabbed the old Falconer Wheel & Brake building to make our home on East Quincy in Riverside.
We generally do late model collision work. Vehicle owners don't often need a body shop, so we follow set policies to keep the repair clear and on track from estimate to delivery. If you have a question or something doesn't make sense, please ask.
You'll find us just south of the Burlington Northern Railroad tracks, a few blocks west of Harlem.

## Services
- Collision repair: Late model collision work using original factory replacement parts and the finest materials.
- Paint: Auto body and paint work with a factory color match.
- Free estimates: A thorough written report of the apparent damage. Call to set up an estimate appointment.
- Detailing: Exterior detail includes hand wash, wheel cleaning, clay bar treatment, machine polish and wax. Interior detail includes vacuuming, leather care, vinyl protectant, interior glass and shampooed carpets and mats, with seats on request.

## FAQ
Q: How do I get an estimate?
A: Call us at 708.447.2727 to set up an estimate appointment.

Q: Do you work with insurance companies?
A: Yes. We work closely with many insurance companies and follow set procedures to help you and your adjuster through the claim.

Q: Can the cost change after the estimate?
A: Sometimes. Modern cars often hide damage that only shows once we start, or parts prices go up. When that happens we document it, let you know, and get approval before we continue.

Q: Where is the shop?
A: We're on East Quincy in Riverside, just south of the Burlington Northern Railroad tracks and 4 blocks west of Harlem.
